name: cortadel-memory
description: Ambient Cortadel memory: push-recall on every prompt, session bootstrap, auto-capture on stop.

base_url.title: Cortadel server URL
base_url.description: Base URL the HOOKS use for their REST calls (push-recall, session bootstrap, auto-capture). Defaults to the hosted service at https://app.cortadel.ai — get an API key from its dashboard. NOTE: the inline MCP server is pinned to the hosted URL and does NOT follow this setting, because Claude Desktop and claude.ai copy the MCP url verbatim without substituting plugin options. If you self-host, point this at your origin (e.g. http://localhost:3001, no trailing slash) AND add your own MCP server with `claude mcp add`, or the hooks and MCP will write to two different servers.

user_id.title: User ID
user_id.description: The user id your API key was minted for. Used by the hooks in their REST payloads only — it is NOT part of the MCP URL, which carries no user segment (the server resolves identity from the Bearer key). Must match the key's user, or the server responds 403.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: API key for your user. Mint one on the server with: dotnet Cortadel.Api.dll mint-key <user>.

client_name.title: Client name
client_name.description: Label this client sends as app_name on the hooks' search requests, which the server uses for access logging only. It does not filter results and is not recorded on memories the hooks capture — the capture endpoint has no app_name field. The MCP endpoint's own {clientName} segment is fixed at `claude` in the pinned URL and does not follow this setting.
